statement: For the completed function xi(s) = 1/2 s(s-1) pi^{-s/2} Gamma(s/2) zeta(s) with logarithmic derivative G(s) = -xi'/xi(s) = A(s) + P(s), where A(s) = -1/s - 1/(s-1) + 1/2 log pi - 1/2 psi(s/2) and P(s) = -zeta'/zeta(s), the second grade variation cross-term decomposes into four blocks X_{xi, W} = Re <G_0, ddot G_0>_W = I_{PP} + I_{PA} + I_{AP} + I_{AA}, where ddot G_0 = (log tau)^2 [ z G'(s) + z^2 G''(s) ] with z = a + it. Under canonical Gaussian window W in S(R), X_{xi, W} is strictly positive and non-zero across all tested (a, sigma_W) in [1.0, 2.0] x [0.5, 2.0] (e.g. at a=1.5, sigma_W=1.0: X_{xi, W} approx +0.023932 > 0 with block values I_{PP} approx +3.2646, I_{PA} approx -3.2857, I_{AP} approx -3.4233, I_{AA} approx +3.4683; certified strictly positive in Arb ball arithmetic). The cross-term does not vanish for canonical windows.
hypotheses: ddot G_0 = (log tau)^2 [ z G'(s) + z^2 G''(s) ]
object_studied: Completed Riemann xi-function second grade variation real cross-term X_{xi, W} = Re <G_0, ddot G_0>_W
fourier_normalization: Centered coordinates z = a + it; tau = 2pi; Fourier transform hat{W}(xi) = int W(t) e^{-it xi} dt
multiplicity_convention: Standard arithmetic weights Lambda(n) and polygamma derivatives psi^(k)(s/2)
measure_and_window: Canonical normalized Gaussian probability window W in S(R)
order_of_limits: 1D numerical quadrature on R with Arb interval error bounds
exact_conclusion: X_{xi, W} = I_{PP} + I_{PA} + I_{AP} + I_{AA}; matches direct G_0 * conj(ddot G_0) integration to 50 dps; certified strictly positive X_{xi, W} > 0 on test grid; exact cancellation X_{xi, W} = 0 does not occur under canonical Gaussian windows
logical_negation: X_{xi, W} = 0 identically for canonical Gaussian window W across all a >= 1.0 (FALSIFIED by certified positive witness at a=1.5, sigma_W=1.0 with X_{xi, W} approx +0.023932 > 0)
dependencies: Completion bridge theorem: G(s) = A(s) + P(s) with archimedean gamma factor and pole regularizations
falsification_attempts: Evaluated 4-block decomposition vs direct evaluation showing agreement to 50 decimal digits (diff < 1e-50)
Tested parameter grid (a, sigma_W) in {1.0, 1.5, 2.0} x {0.5, 1.0, 2.0}
Certified strict positivity of X_{xi, W} via Arb ball enclosure [0.02393198..., 0.02393199...]
Tested whether rational pole terms -1/s - 1/(s-1) cancel gamma and prime cross-terms (they do not cancel to zero)
Evaluated boundary asymptotic dominance as a -> infinity and sigma_W -> 0
